text: Write a program that demonstrates a `do`-while loop running its body even when the condition is false from the start. Fill in the two blanks.
choices: } ___;                             // a condition that is never true
explanation: Verified: 1. The body runs before the test, which makes `do`-while the right shape for "try, then decide whether to try again" — reading input until it parses, retrying a request. It is also the shape most likely to surprise a reader, which is why it is rare in practice, and the honest guidance is to use it only when the once-at-minimum is the point.
